text: Chapter 15: Coenubia's Awakening@The Young Man and the Old Tree
As it is too dangerous for the ark to traverse the Rode Zaag\nRange, you must make your way to the summit on foot.\nGather all your strength and move!
Not only is the trail perilous, but the Rode Zaag Range is\nalso swarming with Coenubias! Clear out the Coenubias and\nmake your way to the top!
You have successfully awakened the Spirit Tree, Puiet, who\nbears the title "Elderroot". However, he's attacking\neveryone. It's a dangerous situation! Calm him down!
You need to help Radi with his research to cleanse Puiet of\nCoenubia. Hurry and collect the required materials!
